exam_exercises.text: Part 1 — Multiple Choice (۲۰ نمره — هر سؤال ۲ نمره)

items.question: Majid needs a dictionary ______ can help him with English words.
The teacher ______ recommended a dictionary is very helpful.
If I ______ a good dictionary, I would learn new words faster.
If he ______ more careful, he wouldn't make mistakes.
The pocket dictionary ______ Majid bought is very useful.
If I ______ you, I would buy an elementary dictionary.
This is the student ______ found the meaning of the word.
If she had more time, she ______ read every day.
The app ______ helps with pronunciation is free.
If we ______ more patient, we would understand better.

exam_exercises.text: Part 2 — Combine the Sentences Using Relative Pronouns (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Combine the Sentences Using Relative Pronouns

items.answer: The teacher who is very patient explains new words.
items.text: The teacher explains new words. She is very patient. → ______________________________

items.answer: The dictionary which I use every day has many examples.
items.text: The dictionary has many examples. I use it every day. → ______________________________

items.answer: The student who studied hard learned English quickly.
items.text: The student learned English quickly. He studied hard. → ______________________________

items.answer: The app which helps with pronunciation is free.
items.text: The app helps with pronunciation. It is free. → ______________________________

items.answer: The book which I bought has a good introduction.
items.text: The book has a good introduction. I bought the book. → ______________________________

exam_exercises.text: Part 3 — Choose the Correct Verb Form for Conditional Type II (۱۵ نمره — هر سؤال ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Choose the Correct Verb Form for Conditional Type II

items.text: If I ______ (have) more time, I would read more books.
If she ______ (be) here, she could help us with our homework.
We ______ (learn) faster if we practiced every day.
If he ______ (know) the meaning, he would tell us.
If they ______ (have) a good dictionary, they would understand the text.

exam_exercises.text: Part 4 — Rewrite the Sentences (۱۵ نمره — هر جمله ۵ نمره)

items.answer: The man who helped me find a book works at the library.
items.text: The man works at the library. He helped me find a book.

items.answer: If I knew the answer, I would help you.
items.text: I don't know the answer, so I can't help you.

items.answer: If I were a teacher, I would explain grammar clearly.
items.text: If I was a teacher, I would explain grammar clearly.

exam_exercises.text: Part 5 — Reading and Choosing the Best Word (۱۵ نمره — هر جای خالی ۳ نمره)

exam_exercises.instruction: Read the paragraph and choose the correct word.
exam_exercises.passage: Majid needs a dictionary who/which can help him learn new words. He found a teacher who/which recommended a good dictionary for him. If Majid has/had more money, he will/would buy an advanced dictionary. If I am/were Majid, I will/would start with an elementary one.

exam_exercises.text: Part 6 — Matching (۱۰ نمره — هر مورد ۲ نمره)
